resources.string: This app needs access to your media files to select and split videos for WhatsApp Status.
Status Splitter needs access to your photos and media files to select videos for splitting and posting to WhatsApp Status.

This app uses Accessibility Service to help you post your own video chunks to WhatsApp Status. The service only activates when you explicitly start a posting session and requires your supervision. No data is collected or transmitted.

Guided Auto-Post mode requires the Accessibility Service to help navigate WhatsApp's interface.

This service will ONLY be used when you explicitly start a posting session and requires your supervision. No data is collected or transmitted.

Tap OK to open Settings and enable StatusSplitter in Accessibility Services.
Please enable Accessibility Service in Settings
Tap Send in WhatsApp, then return here
Please select at least one chunk
